correctness.rationale: Marked singleton point colours propagate to unique joining lines and vice versa; from a normalized projective quadrangle the explicit joins/meets implement affine addition, multiplication, coordinate extraction and hence the field K generated by all normalized mark coordinates. This proves all K-rational point and line vertices singleton. A nonidentity Frobenius automorphism t->t^{|K|} fixes every mark and fixes exactly the K-rational projective points and lines, ruling out any extra singleton vertices. Four or fewer point markers cannot break all automorphisms: a nonquadrangle set is fixed by an appropriate nontrivial homology (q>2), while a quadrangle is fixed by a conjugate Frobenius because e>=2. A fifth point with primitive field coordinate generates F_q, guaranteeing discreteness. Independently built GF(4) full point-line incidence graph and ordinary synchronous 1-WL: quadrangle singleton counts were exactly 7+7; a fifth F4 generator made 21+21 singletons. All 5985 possible four-point subsets of PG(2,4) were independently tested and none became discrete; finite q=4 tests corroborate but are not proof for all q.
